query: We keep forgetting to check renewal risk. Set up a recurring process that reviews the customer ledger every Monday and reminds the owner to act on accounts due for renewal.
expected_behavior: Defines the cadence, owner, input ledger, decision, and follow-up due date as a pull-based operating process
Uses an available host scheduler only when the user has specified or approved the scheduling surface
Does not invent a background daemon or write customer records without evidence
Records the operating cadence and authority boundary as a decision or documented process
